title: Butterfly Life Cycle Art — God's Amazing Transformation
memory_verse: "Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!" — 2 Corinthians 5:17 (NIV)
objective: Students will create an art project showing the butterfly life cycle and learn how God designed butterflies to transform in an amazing way.
content: God designed butterflies with one of the most amazing life cycles in all of creation! A butterfly goes through four stages: egg, caterpillar (larva), chrysalis (pupa), and adult butterfly. This process is called metamorphosis.

First, a mother butterfly lays a tiny egg on a leaf. A caterpillar hatches from the egg and eats and eats until it grows big. Then it forms a chrysalis around itself and something miraculous happens inside — the caterpillar completely transforms into a beautiful butterfly!

The butterfly's transformation reminds us of what God does in our hearts. The Bible says that when we trust in Jesus, we become a new creation. Just like a caterpillar becomes a beautiful butterfly, God makes us new and beautiful on the inside!
activity: Fold a paper plate into four sections. In each section, draw and label one stage of the butterfly life cycle: egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, and butterfly. Use pasta shapes to represent each stage (a small rice grain for the egg, a spiral pasta for the caterpillar, a shell pasta for the chrysalis, and a bow-tie pasta for the butterfly). Glue them on and color your project.
discussion: What are the four stages of a butterfly's life?
What is the most amazing part of the butterfly's transformation?
How is becoming a Christian like a caterpillar becoming a butterfly?
